description: Presents theorems, lemmas, propositions, corollaries, definitions, examples, remarks and proofs with optional titles, numbering and references.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code: The square of every real number is nonnegative.

attributes.name: counter
attributes.description: Shared counter name; defaults to the statement type.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Optional plain-text complementary title; a child with slot="heading" takes precedence.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Optional replacement for the usual type name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Explicit display number; an explicitly empty value suppresses numbering.

attributes.name: numbering
attributes.description: Automatic numbering: none, document, section or subsection; defaults to none for proofs.

attributes.name: qed
attributes.description: Ending symbol; empty by default, or □ for proof when omitted. Explicit values, including empty, take priority.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Statement type: theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary, definition, example, remark or proof.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Appearance: none (no border or background), neutral, brand, info, success, warning or danger.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-theorem>` element presents theorems, lemmas, propositions, corollaries, definitions, examples, remarks and proofs with optional titles, numbering and references.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Statement content | No component-specific mouse interaction. Authored links and nested components retain their normal behavior. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Statement content | No component-specific keyboard interaction. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer or currently focused. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component in the current hierarchy and open its help. |
